sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production CEL ANIMATION in-between key drawings for a 2.5D game. Generate ONE transparent sprite sheet, true RGBA alpha. Keep original adult elf proportions and exact outfit: petite ADULT elf woman, silver-white bob hair and ONE chest braid, pointed ears, charcoal hooded cape with hood down, dark teal dress, tan worn work apron with keys/rope, brown fitted gloves and brown boots. Clean anime game illustration matching these references. One physical shovel with straight rigid wooden shaft, single D grip and one worn pointed steel spade. Correct two arms and two gloved hands visibly gripping the shaft; NO extra hands, no melting or bending weapon, no duplicated shovel. Separate sharp silhouettes. Frame by frame the WHOLE BODY changes pose through natural joints, hips and shoulders lead the arms; no pasted body parts. All characters face generally RIGHT in the same fixed 3/4 side camera, same body size and costume. Each pose is ONE single character, ENTIRE shovel and all limbs fully included inside its own cell, generous gutters, nothing touches or overlaps adjacent cells. True transparent background, NO grid lines, NO numbering, NO labels, NO text, NO ground shadows. Absolutely NO glow, aura, energy blade, magic, motion trail or speed lines. Only physical character plus shovel. Use a large wide canvas and make each pose crisp. Arrange chronological reading left-to-right top row then left-to-right bottom row.
